summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and developments in the retail sector, particularly focusing on court decisions and corporate expansions.

bullets.text: Supreme Court stays P&H High Court order barring Rohtak judges from hearing bail pleas in DHL fraud case.
Bombay High Court quashes FIR against a B.Tech student for an Instagram repost on Operation Sindoor.
Reliance Consumer expands its FMCG portfolio by launching Joyland Dairy Drinks.
Troo Good targets Rs 1,000 crore revenue by FY31 and plans to invest Rs 40 crore in a mega factory.
Tata Motors and Amazon partner to deploy 3,000 electric trucks for e-commerce logistics.
